descriptions.text: Flash loans meet amateur hour. New Gold Protocol hemorrhaged $2 million shortly after launch through price oracle stupidity and broken transfer logic. Team went completely radio silent while security firms dissected their corpse. Their security is non-negotiable tweet aged like milk.

On September 17, 2025, New Gold Protocol (NGP) on BNB Chain lost approximately $2 million to a flash loan exploit. The attacker manipulated the NGP/USDT liquidity pool price using a flash loan, bypassed buy limits by sending tokens to a whitelisted burn address, and exploited flawed fee logic that depleted pool liquidity. The NGP token crashed 88% and stolen funds were laundered through Tornado Cash. Three combined flaws enabled the exploit: (1) the price was read directly from a manipulable AMM pool via getPrice() with no oracle, (2) the sell fee was deducted from the pool rather than the seller, and (3) the burn address was whitelisted, bypassing buy limits.
